parameters.name: clusterId
parameters.description: The ID of the cluster into which you want to import ECS instances.

parameters.name: instanceIds
parameters.description: The ID of the ECS instance that you want to import into the cluster. Separate multiple IDs with commas (,).

parameters.name: password
parameters.description: The logon password of the ECS instance that you want to import into the cluster.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun edas insert-cluster-member --cluster-id b3e3f77b-462e-0000-0000-bec8727a4dc8 --instance-ids i-2ze7s2v0b789k60p0000 --password YourPassword --region cn-hangzhou
